title: Corbell's private source on the existence of the S-4 facility

tellings.quote: And what that is is why I knew that Bob Lazar was telling it as it is, meaning a facility like that exists.

plain: A secret site called S-4, in the Nevada desert, really exists, according to the filmmaker Jeremy Corbell, who says a private source of his confirmed it. That, he says, is why he knew Bob Lazar, a man who has said he worked on unexplained craft at S-4, "was telling it as it is." It would mean Lazar's account of the place holds up.
